item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Uses `lm.acall(...)` under `dspy.context(send_stream=stream, ...)`, which forces the async chat streaming branch when `send_stream` is set."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Captures `streamed_acompletion.call_args.kwargs` and asserts the streamed outbound call includes `stream=True`."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Enables `track_usage=True` on the streamed call and asserts `stream_options == {\"include_usage\": True}` in outbound kwargs."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Demonstrates the async streaming auth-loss behavior by asserting the streamed LiteLLM call receives `headers is None`."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"Provides an offline harness with an async `send`, a mocked async iterator from `litellm.acompletion`, and a stubbed `stream_chunk_builder` so streaming completes without a backend."},{"claim_id":"c6","score":"1","rationale":"Includes a second async non-stream call without `send_stream` and shows headers are preserved there, including the DSPy `User-Agent`."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
